description: Rust SDK for EuroMail — GDPR-compliant transactional email API (EU data residency, Finland). Send emails, manage domains, templates, webhooks, contact lists, and AI agent mailboxes.
rules: send_email() is async and takes &SendEmailParams — use ..Default::default() for optional fields
Returns SendEmailResponse with .id and .status where status is 'queued'
Use template_alias field (String) not template_id when sending with a template
dns_records is HashMap<String, DnsRecord> keyed by purpose (dkim, return_path)
The from field must use the apex domain, not the sending subdomain (em.yourdomain.com)
Agent mailbox: get_next_mailbox_message() → process → ack_mailbox_message() with lease_token
